record.name: Bodyguard
record.description: Bodyguards specialize in keeping clients alive—absorbing fire, interposing themselves in harm's way, and controlling the battlefield to deny attacks.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Protective guardians who put themselves between harm and their clients.

progression_tree.description: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage taken by up to half.
You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class. When you take damage, your client gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class until the start of your next turn.
You can use your bonus action to give a nearby ally a +2 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls until the start of your next turn.
You gain a +1 bonus to Hit Points. When you take damage, your client gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class until the start of your next turn.
You become a master of protecting your clients. Your client gains a +3 bonus to Armor Class, and you gain a +2 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls when fighting alongside them.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a defensive stance with feet shoulder-width apart and arms crossed, ready to absorb impact.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounding the bodyguard with an aura of blue and purple hues, reminiscent of a lightsaber's hum.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A seasoned Bodyguard standing guard outside a luxurious cantina on Coruscant, clad in Mandalorian armor and surrounded by a faint blue glow, ready to defend its client from incoming blaster fire.
contextual_modifiers: Focus on the intricate details of the Mandalorian armor
Emphasize the intensity of the scene with dramatic lighting
